world.name: The Veiled Commons

locations.name: Gravehold
locations.description: A small settlement of hearth fires, kitchen gardens, and familiar faces. Ashfall fever has reached its households; the old shrine is still a place to seek help. Willing ancestral rites and the study of the dead are permitted; coercion and grave theft remain crimes. Toll keepers and ferry households disagree over who owns the repaired crossings. An absent neighbor keeps a named place at the seasonal meal.
locations.localCustom: An absent neighbor keeps a named place at the seasonal meal.

locations.name: Thornmark
locations.description: The region’s busy city gathers an academy, a guild market, and a sworn order behind its stone walls. Fever wards are filling, and scholars disagree over the cause. Willing ancestral rites and the study of the dead are permitted; coercion and grave theft remain crimes. Toll keepers and ferry households disagree over who owns the repaired crossings. A door painted with a reed offers water to travelers.
locations.localCustom: A door painted with a reed offers water to travelers.

locations.name: Blackstead
locations.description: A riverside village where millers, ferrymen, and herbalists trade news. Families are sheltering travelers fleeing Ashfall fever. Ancestral rites require a witness or academy license; raising bodies and binding unwilling souls are prohibited. Toll keepers and ferry households disagree over who owns the repaired crossings. Guests leave a small candle at the public hearth.
locations.localCustom: Guests leave a small candle at the public hearth.

locations.name: The Gallows Thicket
locations.description: Old trails connect both villages beneath a canopy of moss and copper leaves. Healing herbs grow here, alongside hungry beasts and abandoned camps. The nearest settlement’s law governs witnessed acts. Toll keepers and ferry households disagree over who owns the repaired crossings. A bell is rung only after the watch-keeper names the reason.

locations.name: The Fallen Ember Cloister
locations.description: An abandoned sanctuary beyond the forest holds sealed research and the memories of its former keepers. Licensed expeditions may study its ancestral records; disturbing remains without consent invites scrutiny. Toll keepers and ferry households disagree over who owns the repaired crossings. A door painted with a reed offers water to travelers.

world.laws: Local councils set their own rules. In Thornmark, necromancy is permitted; in Gravehold, it is permitted; in Blackstead, it is regulated. Authorities act on witnesses, reports, and discovered evidence. Willing ancestral contact, grave theft, and unwilling soul binding are treated as different acts.
world.culture: The villages value practical crafts and collective harvest work more than inherited titles.

festival.name: The River’s Remembrance
festival.tradition: Families share a public meal and leave a place for absent friends.

rumors: The academy in Thornmark is seeking careful field observers, not only wealthy students.
A moonwise ranger near The Gallows Thicket can teach a refuge ritual without demanding allegiance.
Licensed ancestral research is attracting healers from distant villages.
Makers are needed along the road to The Grave Keep; honest craft can become a life’s work.
Toll keepers and ferry households disagree over who owns the repaired crossings.

yearHistory.title: The missing silver charm
yearHistory.summary: You chose to make time for others. You developed persuasion and devotion.

yearHistory.title: A stranger’s name at supper

yearHistory.title: The keeper’s missing fox
yearHistory.summary: Listen to Kest and organize a safe search. Gain defense and persuasion. Kest remembers being heard.

yearHistory.title: A teacher asks what you want
yearHistory.summary: You chose to make time for others. You developed weapons and defense.

yearHistory.title: A story with your household left out
yearHistory.summary: Ask your caregiver which memory they want shared. Gain persuasion and a named household bond. Privacy remains their choice.

yearHistory.title: An education with open doors
yearHistory.summary: You chose to make time for others. You developed arcana and scholarship.

yearHistory.title: A bell without its clapper
yearHistory.summary: Ask the maker and neighbor to agree on a repair order. Gain persuasion and devotion. The public need is discussed with the people it affects.

yearHistory.title: The apprentice’s first bent nail
yearHistory.summary: Stay beside the apprentice and ask to try together. Gain persuasion and defense. Shared practice makes failure less isolating.

yearHistory.title: A page the academy forbids
yearHistory.summary: You chose to make time for others. You developed devotion and persuasion.

yearHistory.title: A question the old prayer leaves open
yearHistory.summary: Ask who the narrower rule excluded. Gain devotion and persuasion. Belief can include a careful question.

yearHistory.title: The cloak claimed by two children
yearHistory.summary: Hear both children and find another warm covering. Gain persuasion and devotion. Care begins with the people affected.

yearHistory.title: A life you choose for yourself
yearHistory.summary: You chose to make time for others. You developed persuasion and devotion.

yearHistory.title: The craft you still want to learn
yearHistory.summary: Learn enough to collaborate with another maker. Gain scholarship and a professional skill. Add six career experience.

yearHistory.title: A commission with an unnamed buyer
yearHistory.summary: Take the honest household’s commission. Earn 22 gold, gain a professional skill and six career experience. Local trust rises by 3.

yearHistory.title: Your friend’s life beside your own
yearHistory.summary: Help Mara Hollow with the move. Gain ten friendship bond and defense. Happiness rises by 5.

yearHistory.title: A room for the next household
yearHistory.summary: Help agree on a clear temporary welcome. Gain persuasion and devotion. Village trust rises by 5.

yearHistory.title: A household asks for quiet company
yearHistory.summary: Spend time listening without demanding a confession. Gain persuasion and devotion. Happiness rises by 3 and stress falls by 5.

yearHistory.title: The evening your friend had been waiting for
yearHistory.summary: Make time for Mara Hollow. Gain 10 friendship bond and persuasion. Your friend remembers being heard, without learning a hidden condition.
